'''Unusual Chickens''' were large chickens found throughout [[Lumbridge]] castle, [[Falador]] square, [[Varrock]] square, [[Camelot]], and [[East Ardougne]] as part of the [[2014 Thanksgiving event]]. They could be killed to receive [[thanksgiving dinner]]s.

They were removed on [[10 December]] [[2014]] with the introduction of the [[Trading post]].
